B uses the text's definition literally (every a ∈ A has an open V ∋ a with every b ∈ V whose open neighbourhoods all meet A lying in A, i.e. V ∩ closure A ⊆ A). The project's docstring calls the text's definition garbled; B's reading (V(a) an open neighbourhood, the inner U the test neighbourhoods of b) is the sensible one and is equivalent to Mathlib's.
